node_name: EXACT graph node name this report attaches to — must match the node id in the graph (e.g. 'Applied Optoelectronics', 'NVIDIA', 'Amazon Web Services'). This is the join key.
ticker: Stock ticker (string) or null if private.
exchange: Exchange code (e.g. NASDAQ, NYSE) or null.

report_meta.title: Report title shown as the big heading (e.g. 'NVIDIA (NVDA) — Equity Research Report').
report_meta.persona: Whose voice it is written in (e.g. 'Senior equity research analyst, educational use').
report_meta.data_cutoff: What data it reflects (e.g. 'Through the Q2 2026 earnings call (2026-08-06) and market data as of 2026-08-10').
report_meta.audience: Intended reader and reading level (e.g. 'Beginner — every technical term explained in beginner_glossary').
report_meta.no_recommendation_disclaimer: A clear statement that this is NOT investment advice and contains NO buy/sell/hold call.
report_meta.how_to_read_facts_vs_assumptions: One line explaining that 'facts' are dated/sourced figures, 'analyst_view' is interpretation, and 'company_guidance' is the company's own forecasts (not guarantees).
report_meta.primary_source: The main source document, with date and local path if saved (e.g. 'Company Q2 2026 earnings call transcript, 2026-08-06 — transcripts/.../xxx.txt').

beginner_glossary.Term: Plain-English definition of each non-obvious technical term used in the report.

company_snapshot.what_it_is: 2-3 sentence plain-English description of the company and its role in the AI/semiconductor chain.
company_snapshot.manufacturing_footprint: Where it makes things (with sources/dates where known).

business_model.summary: How the company makes money, in plain English.
how_they_make_money: Each distinct revenue-generating activity as a bullet.
competitive_moat_analyst_view: Each durable advantage as a bullet (label clearly as analyst interpretation).
facts: Dated, sourced facts about the business model.

revenue_streams.note: Which period the mix reflects, with source and date.
revenue_streams.latest_quarter_total_revenue: Total revenue for the latest reported quarter, with YoY/QoQ.
revenue_streams.analyst_view: Interpretation of the revenue mix and where it's heading.

industry_trends.why_it_matters: Why it matters to this company.

competitors.differentiation_analyst_view: How THIS company differentiates, and the main competitive risk.

company_guidance_forward_looking.disclaimer: These are management's own forecasts — goals, not guarantees.

financial_performance.analyst_view: Interpretation of financial health and trajectory.

facts.profitability: GAAP profitable? If not, say so (P/E not meaningful).

valuation.analyst_view: Honest read on whether valuation is cheap/rich and why.

scenarios.disclaimer: Illustrative scenarios to frame outcomes — NOT predictions, targets, or advice.

final_research_summary.one_paragraph: A single tight paragraph summarizing the whole report — what is fact vs what is being priced.
final_research_summary.no_recommendation_reminder: Reminder that the report gives NO buy/sell/hold call.
